section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Illustration showing hands using a torque wrench to measure preload between drive pinion and ring gear

content.text: Using a torque wrench, measure the preload of the backlash between the drive pinion and ring gear.

items: (a) If preload is greater than specification, replace the bearing spacer.
(b) If the preload is less than specification, retighten the nut 130 kg-cm (9 ft-lb, 13 N·m) at a time until the specified preload is reached.

content.text: If the maximum torque is exceeded while retightening the nut, replace the bearing spacer and repeat the preload procedure. Do not back off the pinion nut to reduce the preload.

content.description: Illustration showing hands using a dial indicator to measure runout of companion flange

content.text: Using a dial indicator, measure the lateral and radial runout of the companion flange.
If the runout is greater than the maximum, inspect the bearings.

content.description: Illustration showing hands staking drive pinion nut with a hammer and chisel
Illustration showing installation of side gear shaft oil seal using SST tool

content.text: 16. INSTALL SIDE GEAR SHAFT OIL SEAL

items: (a) Coat the oil seal lip with MP grease No. 2.
(b) Using SST, drive in the oil seal until it is flush with the carrier end surface.
